Fountains Return to Disneyland Hotel

Mr. Daps
September 17, 2026
Disney Experiences, Disneyland Resort, Parks

Those who have visited the Disneyland Hotel in recent weeks may have noticed that the fountains near the entrance had walls around them. What exactly was happening was unknown. Now, the walls have been removed, and the results have been revealed. The fountains now look better than in recent memory. It appears they have had new tile added to them, and the fountains are working once again. This adds even more magic to the arrival process at the Disneyland Resort. Not only does it look great, but it also has a wonderfully refreshing sound. These fountains can be found just to the right of the main entrance to the hotel.

Friends of Daps Magic, Mike and Matt, stopped by the Disneyland Hotel on Wednesday night and took the following photos and video of the returned fountains. Take a look (and a listen) at them below!

There are plenty of projects happening around the Disneyland Resort currently. Many of these have led to beautiful enhancements or even new offerings. This is true in the case of the recently reopened walkway between Cars Land and Avengers Campus. When it reopened, a new restroom was added. It was themed to Cars Land.

What do you think about these fountains? Share your thoughts and opinions in the comments below!
